# react-native-platform-components

> Native TextField, DatePicker, ContextMenu, ActionSheet, Dialog, SelectionMenu, SegmentedControl, TabBar, NavigationRail, Button, ButtonGroup, Chip, FloatingActionButton, FloatingToolbar and LiquidGlass for React Native. Every component is the real platform widget on both iOS (UIKit) and Android (Material 3), behind one typed, declarative API. No JavaScript re-implementations. New Architecture (Fabric + Codegen) only. TypeScript types included. Expo config plugin included.

Install: `npm install react-native-platform-components`. iOS: `cd ios && pod install`. Android: nothing to configure; give the app a Material 3 theme to use your colors (the components fall back to Material 3 defaults otherwise). Expo: dev client or EAS Build (not Expo Go); add `["react-native-platform-components/app.plugin", { "android": { "theme": "material3" } }]` to `expo.plugins`, then `npx expo prebuild`.

Requirements: React Native 0.81+ with the New Architecture, Expo SDK 54+, React 19, iOS 13+ (LiquidGlass needs iOS 26), Android API 24+.

Platform-only props live under `ios={{ ... }}` and `android={{ ... }}` on every component.

## Components

- [TextField](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/components/textfield): `TextInputLayout` (Material 3 outlined or filled) on Android; `UITextField` / growing `UITextView` on iOS. `TextInput`-compatible `value`, `onChangeText`, `placeholder`, `secureTextEntry`, `keyboardType`, `maxLength`, `editable`, ref `focus()` / `blur()` / `clear()`; plus `label`, `supportingText`, `error`, `prefix`, `suffix`, `leadingIcon`, `trailingIcon`, `clearButtonMode`, `passwordToggle`, `showCharacterCount`, `multiline`, `autoComplete`; `ios.writingTools`, `ios.inlinePrediction`, `ios.smartQuotes`, `ios.smartDashes`, `ios.mathExpressionCompletion`, `ios.borderStyle`, `ios.labelPlacement` (`above` | `leading`, the Contacts form row), `ios.labelWidth`; `android.material` (`m3` | `system`, the Material field or the platform EditText), `android.variant` (`outlined` | `filled`), `android.dense`.
- [DatePicker](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/components/datepicker): `UIDatePicker` on iOS; `MaterialDatePicker` / `MaterialTimePicker` (`android.material: 'm3'`) or AppCompat dialogs (`'system'`) on Android. Props: `date`, `mode` (`date` | `time` | `dateAndTime` | `countDownTimer` | `yearAndMonth`), `presentation` (`modal` | `embedded`), `visible`, `minDate`, `maxDate`, `locale`, `timeZoneName`, `is24Hour`, `android.inputMode` (`calendar` | `text`), `onConfirm`, `onClosed`. `DateRangePicker` (Android `MaterialDatePicker.dateRangePicker()`; renders nothing on iOS, see `isDateRangePickerSupported`): `visible`, `startDate`, `endDate`, `onConfirm({ startDate, endDate })`, `onClosed`.
- [ContextMenu](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/components/contextmenu): `UIContextMenuInteraction` on iOS; `PopupMenu` on Android. Long-press or tap trigger (buttons inside the content keep their own taps; tap mode needs iOS 17.4+ for that), or `trigger: 'none'` with `visible` (open from JS, controlled; iOS 17.4+), inline sections, submenus, actions with icons (SF Symbols or drawables, or image assets on both), actions that keep the menu open (iOS 16+), preview tap (`onPreviewPress`, iOS), `onPressAction`, `testID` on actions (set on their menu rows, so Detox `by.id` taps them; Button and SplitButton menus too).
- [ActionSheet](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/components/actionsheet): `UIAlertController` with `.actionSheet` on iOS (a popover pointing at the children on iPad and on iPhone with iOS 26; titles only, as `UIAlertAction` has no public icon API); a Material 3 modal bottom sheet (`BottomSheetDialog`, drag handle, no cancel row) on Android. Controlled `visible`, `title`, `message`, `actions` (id, title, image, imageColor, `attributes: { destructive, disabled, hidden }`, haptics, testID: the row's Detox id), `cancelTitle` / `cancelTestID` (iOS), `haptics`, `maxFontSizeMultiplier` (Android), `onSelect(id)`, `onCancel` (cancel row, tap outside, swipe down, back), optional `children` (the popover's anchor). While presented, `title`, `message`, `cancelTestID` and each action's disabled, testID and haptics apply live; other action changes (added, removed, reordered, retitled, destructive, icon, iOS `cancelTitle`) apply at the next presentation, with a dev warning.
- [Dialog](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/components/dialog): `UIAlertController` with `.alert` on iOS; a Material 3 alert dialog (`MaterialAlertDialogBuilder`) on Android, with up to three actions in its button slots and more stacked. Controlled `visible`, `title`, `message`, `actions` (id, title, `role: 'default' | 'cancel' | 'destructive'` (one cancel), `preferred` (iOS `preferredAction`, Android positive button), `disabled`, `hidden`, haptics, testID: the button's Detox id), `dismissable` (Android/web outside tap and back), `haptics`, `maxFontSizeMultiplier` (Android), `onSelect(id)`, `onCancel` (cancel action, Android outside tap and back), `onShow`, `onDismiss` (after any close; chain the next dialog here), `onPresentFailed(reason)` (`'busy'` when another alert/dialog is up: one dialog at a time, `'noWindow'`, `'rejected'`). While presented, `title`, `message` (Android: a presence change swaps in a new dialog without events), `dismissable` and each action's disabled, testID and haptics apply live; other action changes (added, removed, reordered, retitled, role, preferred) apply at the next presentation, with a dev warning.
- [SelectionMenu](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/components/selectionmenu): system menus on iOS; Material exposed dropdown (`m3`) or `Spinner` (`system`) on Android. Headless (anchored to your own view; a real system menu on iOS 17.4+) or inline modes, `options` with icons and subtitles, `selected`, `onSelect`, searchable M3 dropdown on Android. Embedded as a form field: `ios.borderStyle: 'roundedRect'` (UITextField's box), `android.variant` (`outlined` | `filled`) and `android.dense`, `minFieldHeight` and `fieldPaddingHorizontal` as on TextField.
- [SegmentedControl](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/components/segmentedcontrol): `UISegmentedControl` on iOS; `MaterialButtonToggleGroup` (Material 3 segmented buttons) on Android. `segments` (label, value, icon, badge, disabled), `selectedValue`, `onSelect`, label visibility, per-platform styling.
- [TabBar](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/components/tabbar): `UITabBar` on iOS (the floating Liquid Glass bar on iOS 26); `BottomNavigationView` (Material 3 navigation bar) on Android. `items` (label, value, icon, selectedIcon, badge, disabled, testID, `role: 'search'`, iOS `systemItem`), `selectedValue`, `onSelect`, `onReselect`, `labelVisibility`, colors, `barColor`, `minimizeBehavior`, `accessory` (the iOS 26 bottom accessory; a view above the bar elsewhere), Android active indicator and horizontal items.
- [NavigationRail](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/components/navigationrail): `NavigationRailView` (Material 3 Expressive) on Android; on iOS, which has no rail, a column of tab-style `UIButton`s. The TabBar item model (label, value, icon, selectedIcon, badge, disabled, testID, `role: 'search'`), `selectedValue`, `onSelect`, `onReselect`, `header` (React content in the rail's header slot), `menuGravity` (`top` | `center` | `bottom`), `expanded` (the expanded rail), `labelVisibility`, colors, `railColor`. Takes its natural width; the app gives it its height.
- [Chip](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/components/chip): Material 3 `Chip` (`variant`: `assist` | `filter` | `input` | `suggestion`) in a `ChipGroup` on Android; capsule `UIButton`s on iOS (Liquid Glass on iOS 26, prominent glass with the tint color while selected; iOS has no system chip). `ChipGroup`: `chips` (value, label, icon, disabled, closeIcon, testID, closeTestID, accessibilityLabel, closeAccessibilityLabel), `selection` (`none` | `single` | `multiple`), controlled `selectedValues`, `selectionRequired`, `wrap` (rows, or one horizontally scrolling row), `spacing`, `chipMinHeight` / `chipPaddingHorizontal` (points), `onPress(value, index)`, `onSelectionChange(values)`, `onClose(value, index)`. `Chip`: `label`, `icon`, controlled `selected`, `onPress`, `closeIcon` / `onClose`, `closeTestID` (Detox taps the close icon by it on both platforms), `disabled`, `haptics`, `maxFontSizeMultiplier`, `minHeight` / `paddingHorizontal` (points; default the platform's size).
- [FloatingToolbar](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/components/floatingtoolbar): a Liquid Glass capsule on iOS 26 (a blur before); Material 3 Expressive `FloatingToolbarLayout` on Android. `orientation`, `color`, `scrollViewNativeID` (the ScrollView it floats over), `hideOnScroll`, `ios.effect`, `ios.interactive`, `ios.scrollEdgeEffect` (`automatic` | `soft` | `hard` | `hidden`, iOS 26), `android.variant`.
- [FloatingActionButton](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/components/floatingactionbutton): `FloatingActionButton` / `ExtendedFloatingActionButton` on Android; a round prominent `UIButton` (`.prominentGlass()` on iOS 26, `.filled()` before) on iOS, which has no FAB. `icon`, `label` (extended), `extended` (animated shrink / extend), `size` (`small` | `regular` | `medium` | `large`), `color`, `tintColor`, `disabled`, `onPress`, `scrollViewNativeID` (shrinks while the linked ScrollView scrolls down). Positioning is the app's job.
- [LiquidGlass](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/components/liquidglass): `UIGlassEffect` on iOS 26+; plain `View` with `android.fallbackBackgroundColor` elsewhere. `cornerRadius`, `cornerStyle` (`capsule` | `concentric` | number, `UICornerConfiguration` on iOS 26), `ios.effect` (`regular` | `clear` | `none`), `ios.interactive`, `ios.tintColor`, `ios.colorScheme`; `isLiquidGlassSupported` constant. `LiquidGlassContainer` (`spacing`): a `UIGlassContainerEffect` in which the `LiquidGlass` views merge, and morph as they appear, disappear or change frame; a plain container elsewhere.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/): pitch, install, comparison with datetimepicker / segmented-control / zeego / picker / liquid-glass
- [Installation](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/installation): bare React Native, Expo, New Architecture, compatibility table
- [Quick Start](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/quick-start): copy-paste examples for every component and mode
- [Android Theme Configuration](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/guides/android-theme): Material 3 setup, Expo plugin option, fallback behavior
- [Haptics](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/guides/haptics): the shared `haptics` prop, platform mapping, defaults and `'none'`
- [Icons](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/guides/icons): SF Symbols, Android drawables, image sources; `{ ios, android, web }` per-platform icons (the web draws images only and warns in development when an icon has none)
- [Testing](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/guides/testing): the Jest mock (`react-native-platform-components/jest`), and menu action `testID`s for end-to-end tests
- [Theming and Colors](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/guides/theming): design philosophy, theming, accepted color formats
- [Troubleshooting](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/guides/troubleshooting): an Android native control that gets no touches (it lies outside its parent's bounds), Detox waits for native dialogs, harmless "Could not find generated setter" logcat warnings
